violations.description: FOOD DISPLAY SERVICE AND TRANSPORT TEMP (5 pts): Some hot holding units noted not maintaining 140 degrees F or above. Raw chicken cooked rice and eggs noted stored in prep area at room temperature.
HANDWASHING LAVATORIES AND SUPPLIES (3 pts): Hand washing lavatory noted not present in lower level discontine any food preparation in lower level.
FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - DESIGN (2 pts): Some food scoops noted not properly designed no handles. Handles to be stored out of food product.
FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - CLEAN (2 pts): Can opener not properly maintained needs routine cleaning.
CONTAMINATION DURING STORAGE (2 pts): Some food boxes noted being stored on floor in areas subject to moisture.
FLOORS WALLS CEILINGS (1 pts): Floor tiles in ware-washing area noted cracked not in good repair. Lower level floor and floor area inside walkin cooler need reseal.
DISHWASHING FACILITIES (2 pts): Sanitizer test kit noted not provided. (Chlorine = 50 to 100 ppm)

TOILET FACILITIES (1 pts): Adequate ventilation noted not present in mens restroom; fan not working. ( Ceiling fan in womens restroom needs cleaning ) Place a covered waste receptacle near toilet in womens restroom.
PREMISES (1 pts): Wet mops noted in sink need to be hung-up to air dry.
FLOORS WALLS CEILINGS (1 pts): Floor in lower level and inside walkin cooler noted not in good repair needs reseal. Holes in walls and ceiling in prep area need repair.
